audit.why: Early is Syndra-favoured (Viktor weak pre-augment, short 525 E range on Hextech Ray vs her 800 Q), mid stays hers with Luden's, late flips toward a fully-augmented Viktor — the page says all of this.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] has 3 entries, expected 4 — the late-game Viktor augment spike is missing.
audit.why: Viktor's fully-augmented Arcane Storm is his defining late spike and the reason the game must close early; the array simply ends.
audit.corrected: Added spikes[3] via before:null with the full-augment late spike.
sources: enemyKit R text and P text

audit.whatIsWrong: Ult called 'Chaos Storm' (three places) — the kit names it Arcane Storm. Q auto-reset burst tell absent. breakdown.cooldowns has no numbers.
audit.why: Kit file is authority on names; Siphon Power empowers his next basic attack (autoReset flag), which is the step-back cue; Gravity Field 17-13s, Hextech Ray 12-8s are the punish windows.
audit.corrected: Renamed to Arcane Storm in whys[6], late, wants.foe[3]; added the Q auto-reset tell to early; put real cooldowns in breakdown.cooldowns. Note his R is a channel-interrupter zone, and Syndra's E stun can still cancel it since any CC cancels the channel per the kit flag.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: Two spheres near the wave make QE a point-and-click stun and feed R's sphere count — the bank is threat and execute ammo at once.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: With R down you have no execute and only E to escape — past river you are the pick, and Arcane Storm plus one gank hands the game its swing.

edits.before: - Viktor Gravity Field: matchup-defining — The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Scatter the Weak like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Gravity Field: 17s at rank 1, 13s max — when it drops, walk out and you own the all-in window until it returns. - Hextech Ray runs 12-8s; dodge it and his poke goes quiet. - Guard your 15s E like a fifth summoner spell; R (120s) is for kill windows only.

edits.before: Full build the game should already be decided by Syndra's lead, and her R deletes Viktor before Chaos Storm ramps.
edits.after: Full build the game should already be decided by Syndra's lead, and her R deletes Viktor before Arcane Storm ramps.

edits.before: Viktor is one of the best scaling mages, so Syndra's edge is closing the game before he completes his evolutions. In teamfights Syndra's R burst can delete Viktor, but a fully-evolved Viktor with Chaos Storm is a serious threat, so a lead matters. Landing QE stuns to interrupt his W and bursting him with R keeps Syndra ahead of his scaling.
edits.after: Viktor is one of the best scaling mages, so Syndra's edge is closing the game before he completes his augments. In teamfights Syndra's R burst can delete Viktor, but a fully-augmented Viktor with Arcane Storm is a serious threat, so a lead matters. Arcane Storm is a channel — your QE stun cancels the cast — and bursting him with R keeps you ahead.

edits.before: Syndra bullies Viktor in the early levels: he is farm-dependent and weak until he upgrades his Q, and Syndra's Q poke plus level-3 QE stun punish him hard. Viktor wants to soak farm safely and evolve his abilities, so Syndra should deny minions and keep him under pressure. His Gravity Field is slow to arm, so a QE stun can interrupt his combo attempts.
edits.after: Syndra bullies Viktor early: he is farm-dependent and weak until he augments his Q, and your Q poke plus level-3 QE stun punish him hard. Siphon Power empowers his next auto — the wind-up after the Q cast, not the cast itself, is your cue to step back. His Gravity Field is slow to arm, so a QE stun interrupts his combo, and denied minions delay his Hex Fragment augments.
Fully augmented, Viktor's Arcane Storm teamfighting outscales you — close the game before his last Hex Fragment augment or delete him with R before the storm ramps.
